name: dedup
description: Level 7: dedup. Lower level numbers win.

rules.rationale: Above this two units say the same thing. The canonical one is kept and the other is linked to it, never deleted.
Identical sha256 is a free, exact check. Run it before any expensive similarity work.
The first version is canonical; later copies point at it. Deleting instead of linking would lose the provenance.
A Python function and a JavaScript function that look similar are not duplicates. Only compare inside a family.
